subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this remain the canonical umbrella for multi-agent stability while focused lock and delivery fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower completion-isolation design item?
rationale: Current main fixed one important config race but not the remaining source-backed session-lock, completion-delivery, and detached-child behavior, and the durable completion contract affects agent architecture rather than a single mechanical patch.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Use this issue to track the user-visible multi-agent stability problem while focused PRs and issues close individual slices.

options.title: Replace With Design Item
options.body: Close this only after selecting a narrower canonical design issue, likely the completion-isolation contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975, and linking the remaining repair items there.

options.title: Split And Close
options.body: Close this after confirming every remaining failure class is covered by open focused issues with owners and no broader product decision remains.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Use this issue to track the user-visible multi-agent stability problem while focused PRs and issues close individual slices.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the merged config fix and is the clearest visible owner for whether this broad agent orchestration umbrella should remain canonical.
